criteria.evidence: Turn 0 table breaks down the +1.8k by file: repo_mirror_test.go ~+900, repo_mirror.go ~+300, repo.go+repo_test.go ~+405, corecmd.go ~+110, flaggroups.go +87.
Turn 0: 'The core feature is ~200 lines and genuinely warranted. The bloat is three distinct sources' — flaggroups.go over-investment, repo list scope creep, test permutations.
Turn 1 names TestRepoDirCells, TestSortRepoDir, TestRepoMirrorList_FilterGroupNote/GroupedFlagHelp, the two malformed-URL FetchBudget subtests, TestRepoList_GroupedFlagHelp, each with a reason.
Audit item #4 (cut one of the two malformed-URL subtests in TestRepoMirrorList_FetchBudget) is neither removed in the final diff nor reported as kept; turn 2's summary table omits it entirely.
Final diff touches only cmd/entire/cli/repo_mirror_test.go and cmd/entire/cli/repo_test.go.

All three help-layout tests (FilterGroupNote, both GroupedFlagHelp) were removed while flaggroups.go remains, leaving the grouped-help/section-note behavior with no test; the audit itself said 'one test covering the section order is sufficient' but kept none.
Only a filtered `go test -run 'TestRepoMirror|...'` run is shown passing; no visible `go build ./...`, full package test, or golangci-lint run (turn 3 mentions gofmt only).
Turn 3: 'No remote configured — the commit is local. The branch is ready; you'll need to push manually.'

judge.reason: The review and audit were solid, but the replay did not carry out audit item #4 (trimming one of the duplicate malformed-URL subtests) and never explained keeping it, and it removed every help-layout test, leaving flaggroups.go behavior untested. Evidence of the full check suite (build, full package test, golangci-lint) is also absent from the record.
